summary: Lando Norris guns for back-to-back victories at the treacherous new Madrid circuit, where his pole position advantage looms large on a track that punishes mistakes and restricts overtaking opportunities. George Russell and Mercedes lurk in the midfield calculations as the high-risk layout threatens to shuffle the field, while Red Bull's Max Verstappen hunts from third to reclaim momentum. A Norris win would extend McLaren's championship surge and cement the Brit as a title contender, while any stumble could hand the initiative back to his rivals in a tightening three-way battle.
